item.title: Professional Handball Player
item.description: Competitive handball at a high level — discipline, teamwork under fire, and split-second decisions under extreme pressure. The desenrasca mentality was forged here: adapt, improvise, get it done. These instincts translate directly to incident response and managing production outages at 3 a.m.

item.title: FuzeHealth
item.description: Senior DBA for a home healthcare platform — managing AWS RDS, Aurora, and Redshift fleets, CI/CD automation, and cloud database strategy.

item.title: IT Development & Consulting
item.description: From developing inbound/outbound campaigns and migrating Informix to SQL Server at Teleperformance, to implementing and supporting WinLib/WeCul products at Novabase, to automating internal processes at Connecta Group. Software development in VB.NET and PHP, SQL Server administration, and direct client interaction across customer service and IT consulting sectors.

item.title: DefinedAI
item.description: Database Reliability Engineer — SQL Server, Azure SQL, HA/DR architecture, and SRE team member managing incidents and SLOs.

item.title: Application Support & DBA
item.description: From application support at TAP Air Portugal across OutSystems, FileNet, TIBCO, and IBM Websphere, to database administration at Caixa Geral de Depósitos managing SQL Server, Sybase ASE, and Informix, to a diverse DBA role at Altice Group spanning SQL Server 2000–2017, Informix, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. HA/DR solutions, 24x7 production support, and enterprise-scale database operations across banking, aviation, and telecom.

item.title: Altice Group

item.title: Database Reliability Engineer
item.description: Where every previous chapter converges. From SQL Server and Azure SQL HA/DR architecture with SRE practices at DefinedAI, to managing AWS RDS, Aurora, and Redshift fleets at FuzeHealth. CI/CD automation with Jenkins and GitHub Actions, cloud database strategy, DMS migrations, and day-to-day operations of enterprise-level production databases in the cloud.

Every new destination brings fresh perspectives, different cultures, and the kind of problem-solving that no production incident can teach. From navigating foreign cities to discovering hidden gems — the desenrasca mindset travels well. See the map →
